defects.title: The documented options toDel = 1 (genes) and toDel = 2 (enzymes) always stop with an error
defects.trigger: minActiveRxns(m, zeros(5,1), [1 4 5], minP, 1) or toDel 2 (model below)
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) 'Output argument "data" (and possibly others) not assigned a value in the execution with "minActiveRxns" function.' for toDel 1 and 2: the gene branch computes ActiveRxns and never assigns data; the enzyme branch is empty
defects.expected: data with the active genes (toDel 1), or an error saying the option is not available, as optEnvelope does

defects.title: A protected biomass reaction stops the reaction branch with an error
defects.trigger: minActiveRxns(m, zeros(5,1), [1 4 5], minP) with K containing minP.bioID
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) "Unrecognized function or variable 'ActiveRxns'." at line 174: lines 120/126 address the binary of biomass/product as column nRxnsR + bioID (+ proID), but binaries exist only for reactions not in K, numbered in that order; the solver call fails inside try and the catch reads the unassigned ActiveRxns
defects.expected: the binary of the reaction itself is used (none when it is in K) and data is returned

notes: Repro: m = createModel({'EX_a','R1','R2','BIO','EX_p'}, {'','','','',''}, {' -> a[c]','a[c] -> b[c]','a[c] -> p[c]','b[c] -> ','p[c] -> '}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 0 0], 'upperBoundList', [10 1000 1000 1000 1000], 'grRuleList', {'','g1','g2','',''}, 'printLevel', 0); m = changeObjective(m, 'BIO'); minP = struct('bioID', 4, 'bioMin', 0.1, 'bioMax', 10, 'proID', 5, 'proMin', 0.1, 'proMax', 10); data = minActiveRxns(m, zeros(5,1), [1 4 5], minP, 1) -> 'Output argument "data" ... not assigned' (same for toDel 2); data = minActiveRxns(m, zeros(5,1), [1 4 5], minP) -> "Unrecognized function or variable 'ActiveRxns'." (minActiveRxns:174). Reach for the lead: optEnvelope (tested) never passes toDel 1/2 (it errors earlier for delGenes/delEnzymes), so defect 1 is confined to that call form (seed NONE). Defect 2: optEnvelope builds K = exchanges + protectedRxns; it errors when protectedRxns includes the biomass reaction (or whenever nRxnsR + bioID/proID exceeds the binary count). Probe on optEnvelope's own inputs (ecoli_core_model made irreversible, 141 rxns, K = 27 exchanges, product EX_ac(e) index 20, in K): no error, but the product constraint of line 126 uses the binary of FBA_f (20th non-K reaction), i.e. the mis-indexing is active on every optEnvelope call because the product exchange is always in K. Lead must decide whether optEnvelope reaches this defect (its test exists). Also observed, not graded: line 148 increments midPoints inside the for loop, which does not extend the loop in MATLAB; the catch at line 173 swallows the error without ME (VII-C).
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: toDel 1 and 2 never assign data; biomass in K mis-indexes the binaries and stops at line 174 (writer reproduced); default reach
